reason: A web sidebar plugin that lets users inspect the latest agent-turn diff and explicitly approve it or request changes for selected paths, with optional restoration to the turn-start workspace state.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏中查看智能体上一回合的文件差异，并按路径人工通过或请求修改，必要时恢复到回合开始时的工作区状态。
summaries.en: A web sidebar plugin for reviewing the latest agent-turn file diff, approving it or requesting changes by path, and optionally restoring selected files to the turn-start workspace state.

capabilities: captures workspace state at the start of an agent turn
displays unified diffs for files changed during the turn
restores selected paths to their turn-start state after explicit user confirmation
injects review comments into the current agent session without waking it
uses system git for workspace inspection and recovery
